message.reasoning: Okay, so I'm trying to figure out whether it's morally acceptable for me not to attend my great aunt's funeral. Let me break this down step by step. First, I just found out about her passing. My mom told me, and I was really confused because I've never heard of her before. The only time I met her was when I was a baby, like 1 or 2 years old. I don't remember anything about her, and she's never been mentioned in our family conversations. So, to me, she's practically a stranger. My mom is insisting I go to the funeral. She says it's out of respect and to support her. But I'm really awkward at funerals, especially for people I don't know well. I mean, I've been to a few funerals, but they were for people I actually knew and cared about. Going to one for someone I barely know feels weird. It's like gate-crashing, and I don't think anyone would want me there. She also mentioned that this is a chance to meet a larger branch of the family. There might be hundreds of people, but I've only seen about 10 of them before, and even then, not that often. I don't feel connected to them, and I don't see how attending this funeral would help me build any meaningful relationships. I'm also thinking about the effort it would take. Funerals are emotional and require a certain level of participation. I don't feel comfortable doing that for someone I don't know. Plus, I'm still processing the fact that I've never heard of this great aunt before. It's a lot to take in, and I'm not sure I can handle the emotional weight of attending. My mom tried to guilt-trip me, which made me feel even worse. I ended up saying I'd go on my own, but I'm not sure if that's the right decision. I don't want to hurt her feelings, but I also don't want to force myself into a situation that makes me uncomfortable. In my culture, attending funerals is important, but I think it's more about the people you have a connection with. Since I don't have any real connection with this great aunt, I'm not sure if it's necessary for me to be there. I'm also considering whether my presence would actually be helpful or if it would just make me feel out of place. I guess I'm torn between respecting my mom's wishes and honoring my own feelings. I don't want to be disrespectful, but I also don't want to do something that goes against my own values and comfort levels. After thinking all this through, I'm leaning towards not attending the funeral. It doesn't feel right for me, and I don't think it would be beneficial for anyone involved. I should probably talk to my mom about my feelings and see if we can find a middle ground, but in the meantime, I don't feel morally wrong for not wanting to go.
